Interactive **tools** help you fill in a worksheet, make a plan, follow guided steps, or practise. **Skills** are the theory and instructions taught in [Learn](/learn/). Your entries stay in this browser unless you choose to export them.

```{=html}
<section class="tool-finder-search" aria-label="Search and filter Tool Finder">
  <label for="tool-finder-search">Search tools and skills</label>
  <input id="tool-finder-search" type="search" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="Try worry, breathing, DEAR, urge, sleep, or grounding" data-tool-finder-search>
  <div class="tool-finder-filters" role="group" aria-label="Filter results by kind">
    <button type="button" aria-pressed="true" data-tool-finder-kind="all">All</button>
    <button type="button" aria-pressed="false" data-tool-finder-kind="tool">Tools</button>
    <button type="button" aria-pressed="false" data-tool-finder-kind="skill">Skills</button>
  </div>
  <p class="tool-finder-count" aria-live="polite" data-tool-finder-count>Loading catalogue…</p>
</section>

<details class="tool-finder-thermometer">
  <summary><strong>Skill Thermometer</strong><span>Choose the state that feels closest right now and see skills that may fit.</span></summary>
  <div data-tool-finder-thermometer></div>
  <p><a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="/tool-finder/thermometer/">Open the full Skill Thermometer</a></p>
</details>

<div data-tool-finder-catalogue aria-busy="true"></div>
<p class="tool-finder-empty" data-tool-finder-empty hidden>No tools or skills match this search.</p>
```

Tool Finder is educational and does not replace individualized professional care. If a situation involves immediate danger, prioritize safety and appropriate real-world support.
